title: runners/<name>.yaml
description: A machine that runs agents. The file name, without .yaml, is the runner name.

description.description: One line that says what the machine is for.

machine.description: The host name of the machine.

t3_environment.description: The T3 environment id of the machine, or local.

workspace.description: worktree: each lane gets its own git worktree. main_checkout: agents work in the main checkout, one at a time.

ssh.description: The SSH host alias that reaches the machine.

setup.description: Shell commands that the machine needs before the project's own setup, in order. The project's setup and check commands are worktree.setup and worktree.check in clutch.yaml.
